description: E-Bike Ladestationen Düsseldorf is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. This dataset contains the e-bike charging stations in the Düsseldorf city area. In cooperation with the municipal environmental office, Stadtwerke Düsseldorf AG offers several e-bike charging stations in public or semi-public spaces, e.g. at beer gardens, where you can charge your e-bike battery free of charge. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "E-bike charging stations Düsseldorf" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include E-Bike, Fahrrad, Düsseldorf, Elektro, Ladestation. The listing shows 2023-03-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
